notes: Freedits can now have as many big moments as they like (no more limit of six). The Kings & Queens Freedit (reinstall version 16) splits three of its moments so you can time each half yourself: 2b the queen's crown, 3b the glasses clinking, 4b the pawns rising. Leave a b-half unmarked and it plays right after its first half, like before. Also: track order keys only remember the tracks you moved, and you can drag tracks in the render preview to key their order.
